title: A flat local comparison map with regular completed composite
statement: Let R be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] whose maximal-localization completion maps are regular [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. For every prime ideal p, there exists a Noetherian local ring B and a flat local homomorphism φ : R_p → B, where R_p is the localization [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], such that the composite R_p → B → Bhat is regular. Here Bhat is the adic completion at the maximal ideal of B [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and local means that φ sends the maximal ideal of R_p into that of B.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07PT, diagram and proof before the final regular-permanence step

proof.text: Choose a maximal ideal m containing p and set A = R_m. The ideal pA is prime and its contraction to R is p, because p is disjoint from the complement of m.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07PT, diagram and proof before the final regular-permanence step

proof.text: Set Ahat equal to the maximal-ideal completion of A. It is Noetherian, local, and complete at its maximal ideal. The map A → Ahat is faithfully flat, so choose a prime q lying over pA. The scalar-tower identity and the contraction of pA imply that q contracts along R → Ahat to p.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07PT, diagram and proof before the final regular-permanence step

proof.text: The localization R → A is regular; A → Ahat is regular by hypothesis. Compose these maps to obtain regularity of R → Ahat. Its fibres are Noetherian since Ahat is Noetherian.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07PT, diagram and proof before the final regular-permanence step

proof.text: Set B = Ahat_q and Bhat equal to its maximal-ideal completion. Both are Noetherian and B is local. Ahat is a complete Noetherian local G-ring, so B → Bhat is regular. Ahat → B is a regular localization. Composing R → Ahat → B → Bhat twice gives regularity of R → Bhat; Noetherianity of B and Bhat gives all needed Noetherian fibres.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07PT, diagram and proof before the final regular-permanence step

proof.text: Define φ : R_p → B as Localization.localRingHom induced by R → Ahat and the contraction identity for q. It is flat because R → Ahat is flat, and it is local. Its formula on R shows that R → Bhat factors as the localization R → R_p followed by the completion map composed with φ. Regularity through localization therefore gives regularity of R_p → Bhat, completing the comparison assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_flat_local_regular_completion_comparison
    (R : Type w) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (h : ∀ (m : Ideal R) [m.IsMaximal],
      RingHom.IsRegular
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime m)
          (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime m))
            (Localization.AtPrime m))))
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    ∃ (B : Type w) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : IsLocalRing B) (_ : IsNoetherianRing B),
      ∃ φ : Localization.AtPrime p →+* B,
        φ.Flat ∧
        (∀ x : Localization.AtPrime p,
          x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p) →
            φ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) ∧
        ((algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B)).comp φ).IsRegular
